thread:
oliver_pm: FYI customer (FinRegX) pushed back on launch criteria — they require HSM-backed keys + 3yr audit log retention for SOC2. Need quick sync on what we can commit for PRD.

maria_s: who from security is best to chime in? this influences Dedicated vs Private asks.

ashok_eng: cc @julia_sec — technically HSM is doable but ops cost + latency tradeoffs. We should decide MVP vs full compliance.

julia_sec: agree. main questions: 1) is customer expecting HSM for platform master key or per-customer keys? 2) are logs expected immutable (WORM) and stored on customer side or ours?

samir_sales: they want proof for ISO/SOC audit — vendor attestations + exported evidence. Prefer vendor-managed HSM (AWS CloudHSM) but will accept HSM-backed KMS with access controls.

oliver_pm: proposal: PRD split — phase 1 (MVP) = 365d immutable audit logs + envelope keys stored in our KMS (cloud KMS) with rotation policy; phase 2 = optional HSM-backed key management and 3yr retention (opt-in, higher price). Thoughts?

julia_sec: sounds reasonable. For compliance evidence we need: a) tamper-evident logs (hash chaining), b) exportable evidence package for auditors, c) KMS access logs, d) key rotation proof. Also define retention exceptions process.

ashok_eng: implementation notes:
```
audit_retention_days: 365
audit_storage: s3-infrequent + glacier-archival
log_immutability: enabled (hash-chain + signed manifest)
kms_provider: aws-kms (default)
hsm_option: aws-cloudhsm (phase2)
```
We can wire up lifecycle policies and sign manifests daily.

maria_s: cost question from finance — storing 3yrs of high-ingest logs will be material. need estimate before committing final roadmap.

samir_sales: we can price as a compliance-add-on per-customer; customers expecting 3yr retention are enterprise, ok to charge premium.

julia_sec: edge cases to capture in PRD acceptance criteria:
- customer-requested deletions (data subject rights) vs audit immutability
- key compromise rotation & re-encryption evidence
- cross-region regulatory hold (e.g., EU vs US)
- export format (JSONL + signed manifest)

oliver_pm: adding to PRD draft. Acceptance checklist (short):
- 365d immutable logs implemented + manifest signing
- export tool to generate audit bundle
- KMS rotation + access audit logs available
- docs + operational runbook for incidents
- rollback plan if HSM integration fails

infra-bot: deploy-plan created: infra/prd-audit-retention/1223 (staging deploy scheduled Thu)

maria_s: next steps: @ashok_eng to scope engineering work + rough cost delta, @julia_sec to write evidence requirements section, @samir_sales to confirm pricing signal from FinRegX. sync Fri 10am?

samir_sales: ✅ will confirm with customer and push for acceptance of phase split.

oliver_pm: thanks — I'll update the PRD and tag you all for review. :thumbsup:
